sources.supports: Google's archived pricing page listed the model's paid-tier cached input price as $0.01/M tokens by May 1, 2026.

sources.quote:
- Released `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, our fast, low-cost, high-performance Gemini 2.5 model. To learn more, see [Gemini 2.5
  Flash-Lite](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models#gemini-2.5-flash-lite).
sources.supports: Google's changelog dates release of Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite to July 22, 2025, but does not state the cached input price.

notes: The available official archive establishes $0.01 by 2026-05-01, while the official changelog does not specify the earlier cache rate. An attempt to retrieve a pre-change Internet Archive pricing snapshot was blocked with HTTP 429, so the evidence cannot determine whether $0.025 was ever Google's official price or date the transition.
